svg.title: Workflow of Tranquility & Insight in the Training Path

g.text: Workflow of Tranquility & Insight in the Training Path
Foundational Practices for a Noble Disciple
These form the ethical and attentional basis for deeper practice.
This sensitivity leads to a sequence of mental states:
Joy -> Rapture -> Calm -> Pleasure -> Mind becoming

refers to the development of stillness and calm, often through concentration practices like the jhānas. This leads to a developed mind and the abandonment of passion. The mind becomes soft, pliant, and luminous.
Enter & Remain in Jhānas (States of Deep Concentration)
As They Have Come To Be
and are both crucial for reaching higher states of knowledge and release, even aiding in the cessation of perception and feeling. The path is a
gradual training, gradual action, gradual practice

refers to the development of clear seeing and understanding, particularly through discerning the Four Noble Truths and the impermanent, stressful, and not-self nature of phenomena. This leads to developed discernment and the abandonment of ignorance.
